instruction: Candid full-length documentary photograph of an outdoor concrete alleyway with a chain-link fence in soft daylight. On the left, the blonde woman in a white dress (R2) walks forward, holding a colorful bouquet in her right hand and smiling. On the right, the person with the shaved head in a black dress (R1) walks alongside her, looking towards her with a gentle smile. They walk side-by-side, holding hands with fingers interlocked. The lighting is soft and natural with cool neutral tones.
